review:
Adventures is an anime RPG-themed take on BGaming's Bonanza engine, with four heroes who each bring their own symbols. It adds a 10-spin battle cycle: during each cycle you fight a random monster, and every winning combination reduces its health.

Defeat the monster before the cycle ends and you trigger one of three bonus games. Beating the Goblin opens a coin respin, Cerberus starts a three-reel machine that generates a multiplier up to 999x, and the Dragon lets you choose among several options. A bonus buy can start the games directly where permitted. BGaming rates it medium-low volatility with a 2,100x maximum and a 96.1% RTP. The battle cycle makes base-game wins feel purposeful.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
